seed_convention: reset key = jax.random.PRNGKey(seed); raw key at step i = jax.random.fold_in(reset_key, i+1); prospective only.

scripts.scope: Prospective finite replay of actual reset/raw_step states
scripts.intended_objective: Attempt physical bay access, deliberate truthful demand broadcasts and an atomic three-good cycle. The offered cycle may not match the seed-private goals and no delivery or reward improvement is claimed.
scripts.legality_claim: All integers are declared command attempts for active roles. Stop at joint completion and replace no remaining actions; dynamic legality and outcomes have not been executed or certified.

paired_intervention_hypotheses.scope: Paired raw trajectories from the identical reset key and literal shared prefix; replay both suffixes without policy learning.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.intended_difference: Only trader 1 changes from posting request type two to waiting. Intended effect: all three actual goods change owners atomically in A; no reciprocal pair or complete cycle clears in B. Inspect goods_owner and trade_count, not just reward.
zero_or_negative_outcomes: Immediate rewards may be identical because trading has no reward.
The received types may be unhelpful for private orders, producing later negative opportunity cost.
If any actor did not reach a bay or no longer carries its initial item, the intended cycle can fail or differ.
A witnessed atomic settlement proves neither successful deliveries nor negotiation competence.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.comparison_rule: Record actual state/observation/action identities and both trajectories. Report intended effects as absent, negative, mixed, failed or indeterminate if that is what execution shows; do not replace the action script after observing a result.

paired_intervention_hypotheses.intended_difference: Only trader 0 reserves the adjacent western bay in A. Trader 2 attempts the same west move on the next tick. Intended effect: trader 2 remains at the central bay in A but can enter the western bay in B, subject to actual occupancy.
zero_or_negative_outcomes: Both branches can have no deliveries and equal immediate rewards.
Reserving space may only harm throughput and confer no delivery benefit.
If another actor occupies the target or the reservation prerequisites fail, the movement contrast can be zero.

paired_intervention_hypotheses.intended_difference: Only trader 0 reveals in A. Its public signal_type should equal its own private demand while other private demand fields stay absent from other role rows; B remains silent. Compare the legal public projection and each private observation slice separately.
zero_or_negative_outcomes: No immediate reward gain is expected from revealing.
A partner may ignore the signal or use it to compete, so later outcomes can be zero or negative.
Inference permitted by the known permutation or public actions is distinct from direct field leakage; any actual leakage is a failure.
